cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)
project(wirevo_native C CXX ASM)
pico_sdk_init()
function(add_lab name)
 add_executable(${name} main.c)
 target_link_libraries(${name} pico_stdlib pico_multicore)
 target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
 pico_enable_stdio_usb(${name} 1)
 pico_enable_stdio_uart(${name} 0)
 pico_add_extra_outputs(${name})
endfunction()
set(SDK_VALUE 73)
if(SDK_VALUE EQUAL 73)
 file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h "#define SDK_VALUE ${SDK_VALUE}\n")
 add_lab(wirevo_native)
endif()
